A · The choice of one token, stage by stage
are still in play after each line of

Every token starts with a chance. Each stage either removes some (blocking, the shortlist) or reshapes the chances (the penalty, temperature), and the last one picks. The band’s height is the number of tokens still in play, on a log scale. The untrained model is unsure, so its shortlist stays thousands long; the trained model is sure, so the
shortlist collapses to one token — the same code, two very different funnels.

text.tspan: goes one step further, until nothing left can win: “the cat is sleeping peacefully” — exact
The same weights, a different stopping rule: the dashed chip is the word
’s rule threw away one step before its answer finished.
Three ways the choice of words got better: a brake on repeating, sampling that keeps
when the model is unsure and
when it is sure, and a beam search that no longer throws away its best answer — “the cat is sleeping peacefully” instead of “the is sleeping peacefully” on the very same trained weights.
